## Scatter-plot

```{r}
#| label: value-quantity-scatter-2024
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  combined_country_data,
  aes(x = export_quantity, y = export_value, color = geo_region)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = export_value, alpha = str_detect(country, "Rest of")),
    show.legend = c(size = FALSE, alpha = FALSE, color = FALSE)
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = country),
    size = 2.8,
    max.overlaps = 15,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ geo_region, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 0.9, `FALSE` = 0.6)) +
  labs(
    title = "Export Quantity vs. Export Value by Region, 2024",
    x = "Export quantity (log scale)",
    y = "Export value (USD millions, log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
#| label: top30-rest-of-world-prep

# Individually-named countries only (exclude the 7 pre-aggregated "Rest of X" rows)
named_countries <- combined_country_data |>
  filter(!str_detect(country, "^Rest of"))

top30_countries <- named_countries |>
  slice_max(export_value, n = 30)

# Everything NOT in the top 30 -- both smaller named countries and the
# existing "Rest of X region" rows -- collapsed into a single point.
# This guarantees the chart still represents 100% of world trade.
rest_of_world <- combined_country_data |>
  filter(!(country %in% top30_countries$country)) |>
  summarise(
    country = "Rest of World",
    geo_region = "Rest of World",
    export_value = sum(export_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    export_quantity = sum(export_quantity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

top30_plus_row <- bind_rows(top30_countries, rest_of_world)

# For the faceted version: top 30 named countries vs. the 7 existing
# "Rest of X region" rows shown side by side, with no re-aggregation needed.
rest_of_region <- combined_country_data |>
  filter(str_detect(country, "^Rest of"))

top30_vs_region_panels <- bind_rows(
  top30_countries |> mutate(panel = "Top 30 Countries"),
  rest_of_region  |> mutate(panel = "Rest of Region (remaining world trade)")
)

```

## Single Global Scatter (Top 30 + One "Rest of World" Point)


```{r}
#| label: top30-single-panel
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| warning: false

ggplot(
  top30_plus_row,
  aes(x = export_quantity, y = export_value, color = geo_region)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = export_value, alpha = country == "Rest of World"),
    show.legend = c(size = FALSE, alpha = FALSE)
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = country),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.75)) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 30 Agricultural Exporters vs. Rest of World, 2024",
    x = "Export quantity (log scale)",
    y = "Export value (USD millions, log scale)",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
